hero_claim.scientific_basis_en: The combination of Collagen, EGF Peptide, and Centella Asiatica extract is supported by research demonstrating their synergistic effects in promoting skin elasticity, reducing wrinkles, and enhancing skin barrier function. Studies highlight Centella Asiatica's role in collagen synthesis and repair, while peptides and collagen itself are known for their anti-aging properties. (PMID: 42252897, 42280293, 42343000)

tech_story.headline_en: Synergistic Power of Collagen, Peptides, and Centella for Enhanced Skin Rejuvenation
tech_story.headline_kr: 피부 회복력 강화를 위한 콜라겐, 펩타이드, 병풀의 시너지 파워
supporting_facts_en: Combines high concentration of collagen (29.4%) with potent EGF peptides and Centella Asiatica extract.
Leverages the complementary actions of each ingredient for comprehensive anti-aging benefits.
Centella Asiatica extract is known for its soothing and regenerative properties, enhancing the efficacy of collagen and peptides.
supporting_facts_kr: 고농축 콜라겐(29.4%)에 강력한 EGF 펩타이드와 병풀 추출물을 결합했습니다.
각 성분의 상호 보완적인 작용을 활용하여 포괄적인 안티에이징 효과를 제공합니다.
병풀 추출물은 진정 및 재생 효과로 알려져 콜라겐과 펩타이드의 효능을 높여줍니다.

claims.north_america_angle_en: Focus on scientifically backed ingredients like Collagen, Peptides, and Centella Asiatica, known for their efficacy in improving skin texture, elasticity, and reducing the visible signs of aging. Highlight the 'complex' approach for comprehensive anti-aging care.
